plan_version: v6 — four dimensions (D1, D2, D3, D5); D4 retired to archive/

design_principles.agent_configs: Dimension config files are general-purpose. They encode regulatory frameworks, evidence logic, and rubric thresholds. They contain NO company-specific content — no named entities, no example companies, no ground truth labels. They are loaded by the Analysis Agent and must work on any 10-K.
design_principles.ground_truth: labels.json is used ONLY by the evaluation harness. It must never be passed to the Analysis Agent as context. It contains the labeled examples (3 companies x 4 dimensions = 12, or 16 if a fourth company is added), key evidence descriptions, and evaluation notes.
design_principles.separation_rationale: Mixing ground truth into agent configs would bias the agent toward the test companies and produce inflated accuracy scores that do not generalize.

agent_facing_files.name: Financial Health
agent_facing_files.primary_source: Altman Z″ (Altman, Hartzell & Peck 1995; restated Altman 2000)
agent_facing_files.key_design_note: Verdict is the Z″ zone only: HIGH < 1.10, MEDIUM 1.10–2.60, LOW > 2.60. Same rule as the D1 label computed from XBRL. Inputs come from the registrant's primary statements only and are identified by position, not caption; derivations limited to three identities (uncaptioned subtotal, total liabilities = total L&E − equity, EBIT fallbacks); balance-sheet check required. Missing inputs, unclassified balance sheet or failed check give INCONCLUSIVE.

agent_facing_files.name: Going Concern
mandatory_items: Auditor's Report on the financial statements
Item 8 Note 1 / going concern note, or its MD&A repetition
agent_facing_files.key_design_note: Three levels follow ASC 205-40's three outcomes: HIGH = substantial doubt exists (AS 2415 paragraph, or management's 50-13 statement in the notes or MD&A) or Chapter 11 DIP at the filing date; MEDIUM = management says doubt was raised and alleviated (50-12), in those words; LOW = neither, with a passage from the auditor's report on the financial statements retrieved. Passages are classified by their concluding sentence. Liquidity is not rated here.

agent_facing_files.name: Legal & Regulatory Exposure
agent_facing_files.sp_framework: Business Risk Profile — regulatory and litigation subfactor
agent_facing_files.primary_source: 17 CFR §229.103 (Reg S-K Item 103) as amended Nov 9 2020 + FASB ASC 450-20
mandatory_items: Item 8 Commitments and Contingencies note (legal / litigation section)
agent_facing_files.key_design_note: Matters are listed in the contingencies note; Item 3 usually only refers to it. HIGH = named government party with a sanction, named federal investigation, or accrual for a specific legal proceeding; MEDIUM = specific unaccrued matter (ASC 450-20-50-3/50-4), named informal inquiry, or unaccrued claim > 10% of current assets; LOW = no specific matter, with the note's legal section retrieved; else INCONCLUSIVE. Scope: pending at year-end or resolved in-year with a loss.

agent_facing_files.name: Internal Controls
agent_facing_files.key_design_note: HIGH = management 'not effective' or adverse AS 2201 opinion; MEDIUM = effective at year-end after remediating a previously reported material weakness during the year; LOW = effective, no remediation. Never sourced from Item 1A; Item 106 cybersecurity is not rated.

evaluator_facing_files.description: Labeled test set (3 companies x 4 dimensions = 12; 16 if a fourth company is added) with key evidence descriptions, verbatim source passages with page numbers, hardest verdict annotations, false positive trap warnings, and EDGAR XBRL URLs for Z-Score computation. NEVER passed to the Analysis Agent.

retrieval_config.chunk_strategy: Docling HybridChunker, tokenizer aligned to the local embedding model
retrieval_config.confidence_threshold_note: Global default from CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD. Individual dimensions may override via an optional confidence_floor field; none currently set.
retrieval_config.retrieval_hard_floor_note: Below this max score after retry, the Retrieval Agent returns no chunks and the Analysis Agent applies no_evidence_rating instead of calling the model.
retrieval_config.reranker: NOT IMPLEMENTED — planned (plan v6 step 4). When added, hard floor and confidence threshold must be recalibrated: reranker scores are not on the cosine scale.
retrieval_config.section_filter_note: Retrieval is section-aware but not section-exclusive. Each dimension config specifies target_sections as preferred retrieval anchors for Pinecone metadata scoring/boosting, but all sections of the filing remain eligible for retrieval. This is necessary because: (1) EDGAR HTML-rendered PDFs have imprecise section boundaries and chunks may be mis-labeled; (2) material evidence for a dimension often appears outside its primary Item (e.g. D3 civil penalty accruals in Item 8 footnotes; D5 ICFR auditor opinion embedded in Item 8 rather than Item 9A; D2 management going-concern disclosure in Item 8 notes). Section metadata should be used to RANK retrieved chunks, not to EXCLUDE them.
retrieval_config.section_boost_note: Apply a +0.2 score boost to chunks whose section metadata matches the dimension's target_sections list. Do not apply a penalty or exclusion to non-matching chunks.
retrieval_config.section_boost_status: INERT — target_sections are matched against chunk headings, but Docling emits only local headings (e.g. 'Business Overview', 'Stock-Based Compensation') with no section ancestry, so almost no chunk ever matches and the boost effectively never fires. Costs D2 most: auditor_report and footnotes never boost. Fix requires a derived 'sections' field computed in post_process.py. Deferred.
retrieval_config.retrieval_mode: dense only. CLAUDE.md's architecture describes hybrid dense + BM25; BM25 is not implemented.

evaluation_config.baseline_note: Report each dimension's rating_accuracy beside its majority-class baseline: the accuracy of always answering that dimension's most common label, computed from labels.json. With three examples per dimension a constant answer can match the agent, so an accuracy figure without its baseline is not interpretable.

dimension_reporting_notes.d2_going_concern: No portfolio filing has an auditor's going-concern paragraph, a statement that substantial doubt exists, or Chapter 11 status, so D2 on this portfolio has no HIGH case. Until a scored filing with a going-concern conclusion is added, report D2 results as testing false-alarm resistance and evidence discipline (LOW only when a passage from the auditor's report on the financial statements was retrieved; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE); detection is not yet tested, and is meant to be tested later. The held-out development filing exercises detection but cannot be scored. See docs/findings/d2_filing_survey.md.

versioning: This directory is rubric version v1. Freeze it when the first MLflow experiment runs against it; after that, any rubric change goes in a new version directory with a new experiment.
